title: Homemade Ricotta
description: Simple fresh ricotta made from whole milk, cream, salt, and white wine vinegar.
steps: Set a large sieve over a deep bowl. Dampen 2 layers of cheesecloth with water and line the sieve with the cheesecloth.
Pour the milk and cream into a stainless-steel or enameled pot. Stir in the salt. Bring to a full boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Turn off the heat and stir in the vinegar. Let stand for 1 minute until the mixture separates into curds and whey.
Pour into the cheesecloth-lined sieve and drain at room temperature for 20 to 25 minutes, occasionally discarding the liquid in the bowl. Drain longer for thicker ricotta.
Transfer the ricotta to a bowl. Use immediately or cover and refrigerate for 4 to 5 days.
notes: Source: Food Network / Ina Garten. Volume measurements were converted to approximate gram weights.
